topic: Slow Onset Hazards and Climate Change
key_concepts: Slow onset hazards are events that develop gradually over time.
Temperature increase is an example of a slow onset event.
Slow onset hazards are interconnected with climate change.
Slow onset hazards have impacts on communities and environments.
Mitigation and adaptation strategies can address damage and loss from slow-onset events.
Individuals, communities, governments, and organizations have roles in building resilience
The Philippines has current initiatives aimed at mitigating dangers from rapid and gradual
